## The data and the model

`data/legacy/chocolate_dataset.csv`: 68 weeks of real scanner data (see the data slide in Part 9). This file sits in `sessions/01-foundations/`, so it reads the data two folders up (`../../data/...`).

```{python}
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

choc = pl.read_csv("../../data/legacy/chocolate_dataset.csv")
df = choc.to_pandas()
model = smf.ols(                        # the full model of Step 3
    "np.log(sales) ~ np.log(price1) + np.log(price2) + np.log(price3)"
    " + np.log(price4) + feature1 + temp + december",
    data=df).fit()
round(model.params["np.log(price1)"], 2)   # -3.64
```
